Portable setups

Building a Portable Lighting Setup

A practical approach to a smaller kit.

← Explore Apkina

In this guide

  1. 01Start with the shot
  2. 02Plan your power
  3. 03Know your dimensions
01

Start with the shot

Choose the light around your subject, working distance and available space. A compact panel can be a useful starting point for close-up content and small creative setups.

02

Plan your power

Check whether your selected light uses a built-in battery, external batteries or mains power. Consider how you will charge or power it during your session. Runtime varies with output and settings.

03

Know your dimensions

AP3150 measures 151 × 79 × 11mm, while AP3250 measures 151 × 79 × 18mm. The AP475 stick light weighs 320g. Review dimensions, weight and power information together when selecting your kit.

Explore the light

AP3150

Colour in Your Pocket

Take adjustable white light and full RGB colour into a compact setup. AP3150 is 11mm deep and includes a built-in 4000mAh battery.
